task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal output showing 'scdb -i /home/ga/Documents/GSI_corrected.scml' or a SeisComP GUI window showing the successful import/update of station GE.GSI.

task_completion.description: Locate and select the Noto earthquake event within the SeisComP GUI (scolv).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The SeisComP Origin Locator (scolv) window open with the Noto earthquake event highlighted in the event list.

task_completion.description: Trigger the recomputation of amplitudes for the event using the waveform archive.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Amplitudes' tab in scolv showing processing bars or the agent clicking 'Compute Amplitudes' with the correct archive path specified.

task_completion.description: Trigger the recomputation of magnitudes based on the new amplitudes.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Magnitudes' tab in scolv showing a recalculation process or the agent clicking 'Compute Magnitudes'.

task_completion.description: Confirm the new magnitude is lower than the original and commit the change to the database.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The scolv 'Magnitude' tab showing a lower value than the initial estimate and the agent clicking 'Commit' or 'Update' to save to mysql://sysop:sysop@localhost/seiscomp.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The corrected inventory for station GE.GSI has a higher gain than the erroneous one. Because ground motion is calculated as counts divided by gain, the recomputed magnitude for the Noto earthquake MUST be lower than the initial estimate. Look for a decrease in the Mw or ML value in the SeisComP Magnitude tab before the agent commits the solution.
